105: def supervise(argv,cwd,env,slot_seconds,outer_rss_kib,stderr_path,artifact_check=None):
106:     """Never allows a success after the cutoff latch. All descendants cleaned first."""
107:     owned=Owned();proc=None;started=time.monotonic();cutoff=None;peak=0;cleanup=None;error=None;first=None;survivors=[]
108:     stderr_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
109:     try:
110:         with stderr_path.open('xb') as stream:
111:             proc=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=cwd,env=env,start_new_session=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=stream)
112:             # The first sample can race a fast exit; adopted children remain owned.
113:             first=census().get(proc.pid)
114:             if first:owned.known[proc.pid]=first
115:             while True:
116:                 live,_=owned.observe(proc.pid);peak=max(peak,sampled_owned_rss(live))
117:                 if time.monotonic()-started>=slot_seconds:cutoff='slot_wall'
118:                 elif peak>outer_rss_kib:cutoff='outer_sampled_rss'
119:                 elif stderr_path.stat().st_size>65536:cutoff='worker_stderr_cap'
120:                 elif artifact_check is not None and artifact_check():cutoff='aggregate_artifact_cap'
121:                 if cutoff:break
122:                 if proc.poll() is not None:
123:                     survivors=[x for x in live if x['pid']!=proc.pid]
124:                     break
125:                 time.sleep(.02)
126:     except BaseException as exc:
127:         cutoff=cutoff or 'supervisor_exception';error={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)}
128:     finally:
129:         try:
130:             if proc is not None:cleanup=owned.cleanup(proc)
131:         except BaseException as exc:
132:             cleanup={'verified':False,'reason':f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'}
133:         if time.monotonic()-started>=slot_seconds:cutoff=cutoff or 'slot_wall_during_cleanup'
134:         try:owned.restore()
135:         except Exception as exc:cleanup={'verified':False,'reason':'subreaper_restore:'+str(exc)}
136:     return {'worker_pid':proc.pid if proc else None,'worker_initial_identity':first if proc else None,
137:         'worker_exit':proc.returncode if proc else None,'worker_wall_limit_seconds':slot_seconds,'cutoff':cutoff,'supervisor_error':error,
138:         'containment':cleanup,'monotonic_start':started,'monotonic_end':time.monotonic(),
139:         'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'outer_sampled_peak_kib':peak,
140:         'outer_rss_scope':'POLLED_NONATOMIC_SUM_VmRSS_OBSERVED_OWNED_PIDS; overshoot possible; not strict tree/cgroup/kernel',
141:         'limit_initiated':cutoff is not None,'orphan_survivors_at_worker_exit':survivors}

896: def snapshot_binaries(tool: Path, receipt: dict[str, Any], stage: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
897:     """Fixed binaries are measured even without a parseable stock export.
898: 
899:     Failure to measure one binary must neither hide the others nor replace the
900:     child's original exit/exception. The receipt keeps these errors separately.
901:     """
902:     try:
903:         snapshot = binary_fingerprints(tool, {})
904:     except Exception as exc:
905:         snapshot = {"binaries": {}, "required_hashes_present": False,
906:                     "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
907:     required = ["kani_driver", "kani_compiler", "cbmc"]
908:     missing = [name for name in required if not snapshot["binaries"].get(name, {}).get("sha256")]
909:     snapshot = dict(snapshot)
910:     snapshot.update(required_binaries=required, missing_binaries=missing,
911:                     phase="BEFORE_CHILD" if stage == "before" else "AFTER_CHILD_SHUTDOWN",
912:                     snapshot_completed=True,
913:                     state="COMPLETE" if not missing and not snapshot.get("error") else "INCOMPLETE")
914:     receipt["tool_fingerprints_" + stage] = snapshot
915:     errors = receipt.setdefault("snapshot_errors", [])
916:     if snapshot.get("error"):
917:         errors.append({"stage": stage, "error": snapshot["error"]})
918:     for name, item in snapshot["binaries"].items():
919:         if item.get("error") or not item.get("sha256"):
920:             errors.append({"stage": stage, "binary": name,
921:                            "error": item.get("error", "required binary missing")})
922:     return snapshot

925: def fingerprints_match(before, after):
926:     for snapshot in (before, after):
927:         if (not isinstance(snapshot, dict) or snapshot.get("required_hashes_present") is not True
928:                 or snapshot.get("error") or not isinstance(snapshot.get("binaries"), dict)):
929:             return False
930:         for name in ("kani_driver", "kani_compiler", "cbmc"):
931:             item = snapshot["binaries"].get(name)
932:             if (not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("error") or
933:                     not isinstance(item.get("path"), str) or not item["path"] or
934:                     not isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) or
935:                     re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", item["sha256"]) is None):
936:                 return False
937:     return before["binaries"] == after["binaries"]
